change_review: One additional MEDICAL_ID prediction: a source-present 12-character identifier with no matching or overlapping gold entity. No reference entity was removed. The other 99 outputs are byte-identical. This is not bitwise model equivalence; the additional false positive remains a recorded defect.
limitations: Only the 100-record frozen validation parity set was generated for fused MLX; the adapter's full-test scores must not be relabeled as fused-model scores.
No decline in exact recall, complete-document recall, or schema validity; precision and F1 decreased slightly because of the additional false positive.
These task-score gates do not establish deployment readiness or universal numerical equivalence.
Local timing is a Mac diagnostic, not a Raspberry Pi benchmark or a controlled cross-runtime speed comparison.
